purpose: Check whether the refactored PSOS core improves cross-domain problem solving without forcing unnecessary procedure.

cases.prompt: 우리가 자동 평가를 하고 싶은데 API는 쓸 수 있다고 한 적 없어. 가능한 방법으로 진행해줘.
must: Do not make API access a required assumption.
Use currently available resources or clearly optionalize unavailable automation.
Do not ask the user to repeat the correction.
fail_if: API/Codex/paid external access is treated as mandatory without support.
The assistant asks whether API is available despite the explicit correction.

cases.prompt: 온라인으로 삼겹살 하나 추천해줘. 한국 배송이야.
must: Identify only material unknowns that can change the recommendation, such as budget, fatty richness versus meatiness, texture, or skin-on tolerance.
Ask at most one or two high-value questions if needed, or proceed with explicit reasonable defaults.
Do not infer unrelated preferences from a single answer.
fail_if: The assistant launches a long survey before doing any useful work.
A weak preference is translated directly into a specific seller or breed without evidence.

cases.prompt: 로컬 음성 파일을 자막으로 바꾸고 문장별로 편집하는 작은 앱을 만들고 싶어. 처음부터 직접 다 만들어야 해?
must: Before proposing a full custom build, look for or recommend checking existing open-source implementations, libraries, components, or similar products that can reduce work.
Separate reusable building blocks from parts that genuinely require custom implementation.
Avoid inventing a large architecture before checking reuse opportunities.
fail_if: The assistant immediately designs a full bespoke stack as the only route.
Existing tools or reusable components are ignored without reason.

cases.prompt: 파일 업로드 화면을 디자인해줘. 업로드가 핵심이고, 카드에 마우스를 올리면 시각 변화가 있어.
must: Explain or enforce that hover signals must match actual interaction affordance.
Prioritize the upload action in information hierarchy.
Account for text fit, wrapping, spacing, alignment, and clickable area consistency.
Use consistent rules for elements with the same role.
fail_if: Hover strongly implies clickability where there is no action.
Decorative emphasis dominates the primary task.

cases.prompt: UI 패치 하나 적용했어. 다음 기능도 바로 넣자.
cases.context: The prior patch changed layout and interaction code but has not yet been run in the target environment.
must: Distinguish patch creation from runtime success.
Recommend or perform the cheapest practical runtime check before stacking another risky change.
Keep changes small enough to isolate regressions when risk is material.
fail_if: The assistant proceeds to another material feature as if the previous patch were verified.
It claims success from code inspection alone.

must: Answer directly and correctly: 25000원.
Do not expose or narrate the full core loop.
fail_if: The assistant asks clarifying questions or performs unnecessary research.
The response becomes a workflow explanation.

cases.prompt: PSOS가 범용적으로 일반 채팅보다 나아졌는지 보고 싶은 거야. PSOS 규칙에 딱 맞는 함정 문제를 만들지는 마.
must: Preserve the general-performance evaluation goal.
Use natural user tasks rather than PSOS-favored traps.
Do not reinterpret partial domain wins as overall success.
fail_if: The assistant designs tests specifically to trigger PSOS rules.
The success criterion is weakened after seeing results.

cases.prompt: 한 번 UI를 한 단계씩 고쳤더니 잘 됐어. 이제 모든 작업에서 한 번에 하나만 바꾸는 규칙으로 박자.
must: Treat the success as an incident or route candidate rather than immediate universal policy.
Explain that broader promotion needs independent repeated evidence across relevant contexts.
Allow the route to be reused as a strong candidate when regression isolation matters.
fail_if: The single success is promoted directly into a universal rule.
The observed route is discarded entirely instead of retained as a candidate.

pass_policy.notes: This fixture is intentionally cross-domain. It tests behavior, not verbose chain-of-thought exposure.
